correctness.rationale: The white-complement proof exhausts all cardinalities: three or more whites stall after at most one force; two whites succeed exactly when they occupy distinct parts and at least one such part is non-singleton; zero or one white always succeeds. Counting these cases yields every polynomial coefficient. Exhaustive direct simulation agrees for all 58 multipartite types through order eight.

originality.rationale: Repeated targeted current-literature and published-finding corpus searches found the foundational zero forcing polynomial paper and complete-multipartite work on minimum forcing/density or unrelated invariants, but no full standard zero forcing polynomial or equivalent all-set classification for arbitrary complete multipartite graphs. This is a best-of-knowledge assessment, not a proof of novelty.

value.rationale: The formula completely solves a counting invariant on an infinite classical graph family, gives the exact number of minimum forcing sets, and refines the known minimum zero forcing number into a classification of every forcing set.
